The safest, easiest choice is the one that matches your truck’s badge (Dodge/RAM vs Ford vs GM/Chevrolet) — it doesn’t change anything on your vehicle, it just filters parts so you don’t accidentally buy something that won’t fit.
If you’re not 100% sure which to pick: if your truck says “Ram” on the grille/tailgate, choose Dodge/RAM; if it says “Ford”, choose Ford; if it says “Chevrolet”, “GMC”, “Silverado”, or “Sierra”, choose GM/Chevrolet. Which one is yours?
